coverage.A_C_D_E_F: Pose-level projections through existing native-state mapping and manual identity admission. Multiple named tricks within one airborne pose cannot be inferred and are not graded here.
coverage.B: 600ms landing-to-revert plus950ms subsequent Manual/Nose admission retains the existing bounded runtime link.
coverage.F_repeated: Three interleaved rail recontacts, takeoffs, Manual and Nose sections retain both mode histories; later same-family sections have increasing difficulty.
coverage.G: Repeated observed revert signals neither farm multiplier nor extend the accepted1100ms deadline.
coverage.H: Physical bail or unknown owner/state resets continuity, repeated loss is idempotent, and fresh recovery starts without old mode fatigue.
coverage.sampling: 17ms and34ms sampled intervals with interleaved zero-time duplicate observations.
coverage.admission: Fresh matching Manual/Nose history edges are required. Contact alone and consumed labels after OFF/context reset cannot restore a section.
coverage.dropout: Score-display activity may lapse while fresh same-owner contact maintains an admitted manual. Unknown physical observation remains a hard boundary.
coverage.terminal: 740ms continuation retains history;750ms expiry resets it. A physical bail on the expiry poll wins over model banking. Model outcomes do not establish native monetary settlement.

result: All tested contracts hold on unchanged runtime source. No continuity/fatigue defect reproduced; no runtime refactor or tuning change.
fixture_correction: The initial expiry fixture allowed800ms from physical contact exit, omitting the accepted100ms contact-retention period before750ms landing grace. Extending observation to1000ms corrected the fixture without changing runtime behavior.
remaining_native_observation: Full complex-chain acceptance still requires a contiguous owner-matched native event/history/contact trace through each intended named airborne action, repeated Manual/Nose section and rail recontact, with measured cadence and independent terminal/recovery evidence. In particular, pose alone cannot distinguish multiple midair actions or whether a short two-wheel interval represents a fresh independently named manual section. Existing historical mechanic denominators remain scoped to their original builds and contexts.
